_comment: Claim-evidence registry (correctness-reset Phase 6, INV-CLAIM-001..004). Every numeric/absolute PUBLIC claim must have an entry here whose status is 'supported' (with reproducible evidence) or 'unsupported' (then the claim text must carry no numeric magnitude). The validator (validate_claim_evidence.py) enforces the rules and is a CI gate. A real control-group benchmark (Phase 8) is required before a savings magnitude may be marked supported.

claims.claim_text: Cost savings — routes offloadable work to cheaper models; magnitude depends on workload
claims.reason: No reproducible control-group (LLM Router-off vs on) benchmark exists yet; the prior '35-80% proven' figure was retracted. A magnitude may be asserted only once Phase 8 (control-group benchmark) produces a BENCH artifact.
